title: Reactivity of Zinc Fingers in Oxidizing Environments: Insight from Molecular Models Through Activation Strain Analysis.
authors: Zeppilli, Davide; Madabeni, Andrea; Nogara, Pablo A; Rocha, Joao B T; Orian, Laura
one_liner_zh: 该文用DFT和分子对接研究锌指蛋白Zn离子配位核心与H2O2的氧化反应机理，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合相关的锌指结构域，但聚焦金属配位化学而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: The reactivity of Zn(2+) tetrahedral complexes with H(2)O(2) was investigated in silico, as a first step in their disruption process. The substrates were chosen to represent the cores of three different zinc finger protein motifs, i. e., a Zn(2+) ion coordinated to four cysteines (CCCC), to three cysteines and one histidine (CCCH), and to two cysteines and two histidines (CCHH). The cysteine and histidine ligands were further simplified to methyl thiolate and imidazole, respectively. H(2)O(2) was chosen as an oxidizing agent due to its biological role as a metabolic product and species involved in signaling processes. The mechanism of oxidation of a coordinated cysteinate to sulfenate-kappaS and the trends for the different substrates were rationalized through activation strain analysis and energy decomposition analysis in the framework of scalar relativistic Density Functional Theory (DFT) calculations at ZORA-M06/TZ2P ae // ZORA-BLYP-D3(BJ)/TZ2P. CCCC is oxidized most easily, an outcome explained considering both electrostatic and orbital interactions. The isomerization to sulfenate-kappaO was attempted to assess whether this step may affect the ligand dissociation; however, it was found to introduce a kinetic barrier without improving the energetics of the dissociation. Lastly, ligand exchange with free thiolates and selenolates was investigated as a trigger for ligand dissociation, possibly leading to metal ejection; molecular docking simulations also support this hypothesis.
abstract_zh: 在硅上研究了Zn(2+)四面体配合物与H(2)O(2)的反应性，作为其解离过程的第一步。所选底物代表三种不同锌指蛋白基序的核心，即一个Zn(2+)离子分别与四个半胱氨酸（CCCC）、三个半胱氨酸和一个组氨酸（CCCH）以及两个半胱氨酸和两个组氨酸（CCHH）配位。半胱氨酸和组氨酸配体进一步简化为甲基硫醇盐和咪唑。选择H(2)O(2)作为氧化剂，因其在生物体内作为代谢产物及参与信号传导过程的物种。通过标量相对论密度泛函理论（DFT）计算（ZORA-M06/TZ2P ae // ZORA-BLYP-D3(BJ)/TZ2P）框架下的活化应变分析和能量分解分析，合理化了配位半胱氨酸氧化为亚磺酸根-kappaS的机制及不同底物的趋势。CCCC最易被氧化，这一结果通过静电和轨道相互作用得以解释。尝试了向亚磺酸根-kappaO的异构化，以评估该步骤是否可能影响配体解离；然而，发现该步骤引入了动力学能垒，并未改善解离的能量学。最后，研究了与游离硫醇盐和硒醇盐的配体交换作为配体解离的触发因素，可能导致金属释放；分子对接模拟也支持这一假设。
